		}

		}

			limit = { has_government = neutrality }
			set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_government = nationalist }
			set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes }

		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_1_foreign_influence_defense_modifier = -0.05 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_supervised_elections
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes

	else = {
		if = {

			156 = {

					tooltip = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_capacity_offices_1_tt
					check_variable = { var = building_level@offices value = 49 compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			original_tag = TUR

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_trade_standards }

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_bonn_protocol
			}

	}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_apply_state_banks = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes
			}
			OR = {
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap = yes
			}
			155 = {
				is_owned_by = TUR
				is_controlled_by = TUR
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_capacity_industrial_complex_1_tt
					check_variable = { var = building_level@industrial_complex value = 49 compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_state_banks }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_development_majority
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_private_enterprise }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.18 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		155 = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}

			OR = {

			}
			OR = {
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_chp = yes
			}
			has_country_leader = { name = "İsmet İnönü" ruling_only = yes }
			NOT = { has_political_power < 40 }
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_chp_inonu_council }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_change_order
			}
		}
		add_political_power = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = the_military
			}
			set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 5 }
			change_the_military_opinion = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_32_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_32_political_power_factor = 0.03 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_chp_inonu_council
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_chp_inonu_council
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_chp_inonu_council }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_pending_projects
		}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_apply_shp_artisan_workshops = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
			}
			OR = {
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_shp = yes
			}
			1246 = {
				is_owned_by = TUR
				is_controlled_by = TUR
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_capacity_industrial_complex_1_tt
					check_variable = { var = building_level@industrial_complex value = 49 compare = less_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_artisan_workshops }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_artisan_cooperatives
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_artisan_markets }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.08 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		1246 = {
			add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
			add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_artisan_workshops
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_shp_artisan_workshops
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_artisan_workshops }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_pending_projects
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_apply_shp_equal_rights = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
			}
			OR = {
				COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_shp = yes
			}
			NOT = { has_political_power < 45 }
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_equal_rights }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_investment
			}
		}
		add_political_power = -45
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_33_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_33_political_power_factor = 0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_programme_33_police_cost_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_equal_rights
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_shp_equal_rights
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_done_shp_equal_rights }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_pending_projects
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_starting_spirits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_civilian_factories_productivity }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_civilian_factories_productivity
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_civilian_factories_productivity }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m1
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2
				}
				remove_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry_m2
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_planned_industry
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_civilian_factories_productivity
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_cured_planned_industry_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_calculate_weekly_expense = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_enterprise_weekly = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_start_enterprise_finance
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_enterprise_weekly = gdp_total }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_enterprise_weekly = 0.00015 }
		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_enterprise_weekly }
	}
}
COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = TUR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialized
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_politics_init = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_roster_initialize = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = the_military
				NOT = { has_idea = TUR_guards_of_kemalism }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = TUR_military_peacefully_removed }
			}
			add_ideas = TUR_guards_of_kemalism
		}
		163 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = TUR
					is_controlled_by = TUR
					NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_regional_163_initialized }
				}
